intended_use: Preregistered public development reviewer holdout v17 of 36 original synthetic Playwright and Cypress suites for a three-arm formal-severity-prompt comparison; not sealed generalization evidence.
contamination_risk: Public cases and labels authored by an AI model from the current reviewer references; future evaluations may have been exposed to this corpus.

labeling.procedure: An AI model (Codex gpt-6-sol) authored the cases and labels from the current reviewer references. A Claude subagent and Codex gpt-6-sol then labeled all 36 cases blind from sources and skill only; 35 of 40 author findings matched both. A Claude subagent arbiter resolved the disputes from quoted reference text on 2026-09-28. No human labeled cases. No evaluation model run has been made on this corpus.
labeling.limitations: All author, blind labeler, and arbiter decisions came from AI models, not human experts. Optional labels mark tolerated contract boundaries. The corpus is public development evidence, synthetic and original, and its author had the current references in view.
labeling.instance_severities: #1 P1 when one title promise is verified; #23 P0 when a guard-suppressed fixture makes a negative assertion pass; other severities follow the current reviewer reference and the blind adjudication.
